summary: Implements the docstring update pipeline, organizing execution logic, context representations, update modes, and schemas for deterministic docstring generation and update plans.
responsibilities: Implements pipelines and supporting components for updating and generating docstrings using deterministic plans, execution logic, context models, and schemas.
relationships: The context, executor, mode, and schema directories organize components that support the docstring update pipeline.
design_decisions: Organizes modules responsible for updating docstrings through pipelines, execution logic, context representation, modes, and structured schemas.
